name: campus-treehole-tooling
description: CloudBase CLI：将 cloudbaserc.json 中的环境变量同步到云端（与小程序 npm 无关）

scripts.cloud:push-fn-env: node -e "const{spawn}=require('child_process');function run(n,c){return new Promise((res,rej)=>{const p=spawn('npx',['-p','@cloudbase/cli@latest','tcb','config','update','fn',n],{stdio:['pipe','inherit','inherit'],shell:true,cwd:__dirname});p.stdin.write('\r\n');p.on('close',c=>c===0?res():rej(new Error('exit '+c)));});} (async()=>{await run('adminPanel');await run('dbOperations');})();"
scripts.cloud:deploy-bugfix: node scripts/cloud-cli.js fn deploy dbOperations adminPanel notifySender userReferral bindInviteEmployee --force
scripts.admin:sync: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const {getAdminSourcePath}=require('./scripts/env');const path=require('path');const src=getAdminSourcePath();const dst=path.join(__dirname,'hosting','admin.html');if(!fs.existsSync(src))throw new Error('找不到 '+src);fs.copyFileSync(src,dst);console.log('已同步到 hosting/admin.html');"
scripts.admin:deploy: npm run admin:sync && node scripts/cloud-cli.js hosting deploy hosting/admin.html admin.html
